pages.title: Chronosteel Ingot
pages.text: Neutronium forged in a pocket of stopped time. Because time does not pass for it, it never ages, rusts or wears; a scratch on it is permanent but never deepens. It is cool and very heavy, and its surface reflects a fraction of a second late.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Breaking a Block of Chronosteel into ingots by hand was simple enough. Forging the block in the first place took a pocket of stopped time that I will not describe here.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Plasma Metallurgy.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Assembly Matrix, Block of Chronosteel, Causal Shield Lattice, Causal Shielding Plate, Chronal Accelerator, Chrono Loom, Chronoplastic Gasket, Chronosteel Coil Block and more.
